name: Doing For Others
overview: Scripture calls believers to actively serve others with love and generosity, reflecting the heart of Christ who gave Himself for the world. Jesus teaches that meeting the needs of the hungry, thirsty, and strangers is a tangible expression of discipleship and love toward one another. The principle of giving is highlighted as both a blessing and a responsibility, promising that generosity will be reciprocated. Ultimately, doing for others demonstrates the love that identifies followers of Christ and fulfills His command to support the weak.
